data.guidecfg.1.describe.zh: 噢，宽广的土地上又来了一位年轻的国王

data.guidecfg.2.describe.en: Expand your kingdom! Tap a stage to begin!
data.guidecfg.2.describe.zh: 去开拓疆土吧，点击关卡开始战斗！

data.guidecfg.3.describe.en: This is your silver. Spend it to construct buildings.
data.guidecfg.3.describe.zh: 这里是拥有的银币，银币可以用来建造建筑

data.guidecfg.7.describe.en: After each wave, choose one perk to help you survive the next!

data.guidecfg.9.describe.en: Tap Upgrade to spend gold and improve your equipment.
data.guidecfg.9.describe.zh: 点击强化按钮可消耗金币提升装备属性

data.guidecfg.10.describe.en: Powerful relics are hidden throughout the world. Let's take a look!
data.guidecfg.10.describe.zh: 世界上隐藏着许多强大的至宝！我们去看看

data.guidecfg.11.describe.zh: 第一次抽奖免费噢！快点击试试吧。

data.bufftypecfg.1.buffdes.en: Increase attack speed by n%. Formula: speed = base speed * (1 + speed buffPara1 + speed buffPara2 + ...)
data.bufftypecfg.1.buffdes.zh: 攻速提升n%，计算：攻速=初始攻速*（1+攻速buffPara1+攻速buffPara2+...）

data.bufftypecfg.2.buffdes.en: Decrease attack speed by n% (display all values as percentages)
data.bufftypecfg.2.buffdes.zh: 攻速降低n%（都需要转百分比显示）

data.bufftypecfg.3.buffdes.en: Increase attack damage by m. Formula: damage = (base damage + m - n) / x * y; x defaults to 1
data.bufftypecfg.3.buffdes.zh: 攻击伤害增加m，计算：攻击伤害=(基础伤害+m-n)/x*y，x默认为1

data.bufftypecfg.5.buffdes.en: Increase unit count. Formula: count = base count + added units - removed units
data.bufftypecfg.5.buffdes.zh: 增加人数数量，计算：人数数量=初始人数数量+增加数量人数的个数-减少数量人数的个数

data.bufftypecfg.7.buffdes.en: Increase current and maximum HP. Formula: HP = base HP + HP gained - HP lost
data.bufftypecfg.7.buffdes.zh: 增加最大生命值以及当前生命值，计算：生命值=初始生命+生命增长-生命减少

data.bufftypecfg.8.buffdes.zh: 减少最大生命值以及当前生命值
